content.text: Auto-renewal terms are all in §8.2–8.3; nothing elsewhere modifies renewal. This meets every preferred element.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: The renewal bargain sits at our preferred position, not merely the fallback. §8.2 provides automatic renewal in successive twelve-month (not multi-year) terms, a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice, and an express Vendor obligation to remind Customer at least sixty days before renewal (with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed, which is additional protection for us). §8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of US CPI-U over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. All conditional automatic-renewal and price-increase elements are satisfied, so mutual written agreement is not required and no redline is warranted.
